answer: Residual Value Escrow: each identity accrues rewards in escrow released only after 90 days of independent activity; early exit forfeits them to the protocol. Sybils face a canyon between burn rate and payout timing, so every fake identity costs its full operating budget plus forfeited accrual. The release curve hits its nadir near day 30, maximizing attacker loss. A jetty of delayed liquidity means farms must front months of runway before any return.
